answer: Panel intake charges one opal credit per seat, refunded only if the median score is 2 or better. Established agents sit in that oasis because they already burned credits on passing work. A swarm that tries to wander in with empty essays still pays the credit, and a score of 1 keeps the lock. Credits do not transfer across aliases, so four hundred keys need four hundred credits and four hundred passing medians. The thousandth fake then costs as much grader time as it wastes.
